title: P0.1: Custom→Content→Custom Roundtrip Preserves Body
verifies: switching a custom template from Custom→Content→Custom mode restores the exact original raw body text from the stash with no data loss

title: P0.2: Edit Custom Template → Save in Custom Mode → Kind = 'custom'
verifies: editing a custom template and saving in Custom mode persists kind=custom and the modified body via API verification

title: P1.1: Legacy Banner + 'Start Content Version' Converts Custom → Content
verifies: the legacy banner appears for existing custom templates, the Start Content Version button converts to content mode, hides the banner, and the original body is preserved in the stash

title: P1.2: Clone Custom Template Preserves Kind → Opens in Custom Mode
verifies: cloning a custom template opens the editor in Custom mode with Copy_of_ prefixed name, editable name field, and matching body; save creates a new independent template

title: P1.3: New Template Content→Custom Gets RAW_PAYLOAD_STARTER (Slack Example)
verifies: a brand-new template in Content mode, when switched to Custom mode without modifications, receives the Slack RAW_PAYLOAD_STARTER instead of serialized ContentSpec

title: P1.4: Type Toggle (HTTP ↔ Email) in Custom Mode Shows/Hides Email Title Input
verifies: switching the template type between HTTP and Email in custom mode toggles the email title input field visibility correctly

title: P2.1: Content Mode Body Modified → Custom Gets Serialized Spec (Not Starter)
verifies: when the content spec is modified by the user and then switched to Custom mode, the body contains the serialized ContentSpec JSON with modifications, not the RAW_PAYLOAD_STARTER

title: P2.2: Cancel Button Discards Unsaved Changes and Returns to List
verifies: clicking Cancel from the editor dismisses the form without saving, returns to the templates list, and the original template body is preserved via API verification

title: P2.3: Name Readonly in Edit Mode
verifies: when editing an existing template, the name input has the readonly attribute, contains the correct template name, and the title displays Update template
